digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verified CI on GitHub Actions
propositions: macOS default tier test execution time grew from 677.41s to 1453.10s (+14m31s) between Aug 1 and current due to ~91k new test lines and ~4.1k additional selected tests

specific unit tests execute expensive mechanics: 120s missing-field budget test, five 5s real sleeps in patched code, 25s Jira retry path, 15s timeout tests, and repeated real builds collectively add material critical-path time

mutation testing landed at e0b3fdfc8e but was not the regression cause: only 5 of 62 post-mutation runs selected mutation, active runs averaged 33.0m while skipped runs averaged 36.5m, and mutation never extended the measured critical path

macOS process/APFS contention under GitHub Free org limits (20 total jobs/5 macOS) amplifies deterministic test work nonlinearly, with queue time ranging from 0.72m to 27.57m median to mean across sample
per-xdist-worker wiki corpus recomputation and immutable AST recomputation by four independent guards add repeated work per process that could be computed once

proposed remediations (fake clock, injected sleepers, process-level caching, per-worker corpus caching, socket/process timing windows) preserve coverage and do not increase aggregate runner consumption
